issues.legal_issue: The minimum-term provision for tenancies commencing after the amendment does not bar termination on an independently available statutory ground before the minimum term expires; it also permits termination when the tenancy term, which must meet the minimum duration, expires.
material_facts: The appeals concerned the construction of provisions governing termination of agricultural tenancies that commenced after the relevant amendment.
The landowner argued that the minimum three-year term prevented termination on any ground before that term expired.
The Court considered the provisions listing general grounds for termination alongside the separate provisions governing pre-amendment and post-amendment tenancies.
issues.conclusion: The minimum-term provision does not suspend the general statutory grounds for termination. A post-amendment tenancy may be terminated on a general statutory ground, or when its term expires provided that term is not shorter than the statutory minimum. The appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 7, 7-A and 8 of the PEPSU Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act, 1955, section 7 lists grounds available for termination of any tenancy; section 7-A adds grounds for tenancies subsisting when the Second Amendment Act, 1956 commenced; and section 8 provides for termination of a tenancy commencing after that amendment upon expiry of its term, which cannot be shorter than three years. Section 7 permits termination either on its listed grounds or in accordance with other provisions of the Act. Reading section 8 as barring all termination for three years would produce the anomalous result that a landowner could not act even if the tenant used the land so as to render it unfit. The Court also noted that its construction accorded with the consistent view of the Punjab High Court; it cited no particular earlier case.

predicates.post_amendment_tenancy_termination_appea: The proceeding is an appeal concerning termination of a tenancy that began after a change in the governing tenancy law.
predicates.independent_termination_ground_exists: The tenant's conduct or circumstances satisfy a ground for termination that applies independently of the minimum-term provision.
predicates.tenancy_term_expired_after_minimum_durat: The tenancy term has expired and lasted at least as long as the required minimum duration.
predicates.tenancy_termination_is_permitted_on_an_i: The tenancy may be terminated either on an independently available ground or after expiry of a term that meets the required minimum duration.

issues.definition: For an appeal concerning a post-change tenancy, termination is permitted if an independent ground exists or the tenancy term has expired after meeting the minimum duration.
